title: MAKING ML MODELS FAIRER THROUGH EXPLANATIONS: THE CASE OF LIMEOUT
findings: The paper does not contain any findings related to religion. The analysis is focused on fairness concerning non-religious sensitive attributes such as race, sex, and marital status across several datasets.
